# Community Rule Column 9 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 1QS (Cave 1), Col. 9 | **Condition:** complete

---

**9:1** They-shall-not depart from any counsel-of the-Torah to walk in all the-stubbornness-of their heart, but they-shall-be-governed by the-first

**9:2** regulations in-which the-men-of the-community began to-be-instructed, until the-coming-of a prophet and the-Messiahs-of Aaron and Israel.

**9:3** These-are the-statutes for the-Instructor to-walk by-them with every living-being, according-to the-regulation-of

**9:4** every time and according-to the-weight-of every man: to-do the-will-of God according-to all

**9:5** that-has-been-revealed for-each-and-every time, and to-acquire all the-wisdom that-has-been-found according-to

**9:6** the-times, and the-statute-of the-time. And to-separate and to-weigh the-Sons-of-Righteousness according-to their spirits,

**9:7** and to-hold-fast the-chosen-ones-of the-time according-to his-will, as he-has-commanded. Each-man

**9:8** according-to his spirit shall-he-judge; according-to the-cleanness-of his hands shall-he-be-admitted, and according-to his understanding

**9:9** shall-he-be-advanced. So-also his-love together-with his-hatred. He-shall-not reprove and-not dispute

**9:10** with the-men-of the-pit, but he-shall-conceal the-counsel-of the-Torah in-the-midst-of the-men-of injustice.

**9:11** He-shall-reprove with-true-knowledge and with-righteous-judgment those-who-choose the-way, each-man according-to his spirit,

**9:12** according-to the-regulation-of the-time, to-guide-them in-knowledge and to-instruct-them in the-mysteries-of

**9:13** wonder and truth, so-that in-the-midst-of the-men-of the-community they-may-walk perfectly, each-man with his neighbor,

**9:14** in all that-has-been-revealed to-them. This-is the-time for-the-clearing-of the-way

**9:15** to the-wilderness. He-shall-instruct-them in all that-is-found to-be-done at this time, and to-be-separated

**9:16** from every man who has not turned his way from all injustice.

**9:17** These-are the-regulations-of the-way for the-Instructor in these times, for his loving and for his hating:

**9:18** eternal hatred for the-men-of the-pit in a spirit-of concealment, to-leave to-them property and the-labor-of

**9:19** hands like a slave to the-one-who-rules over-him, and humility before the-one-who-has-dominion over-him.

**9:20** And each-man shall-be a zealot for the-statute and its time, for the-day-of vengeance. He-shall-do

**9:21** the-will-of-God in all the-undertaking-of his hands and in all his dominion, as

**9:22** he-has-commanded. And everything that-happens to-him, he-shall-delight in-it willingly; and apart-from the-will-of

**9:23** God nothing shall-please-him. He-shall-delight in all the-words-of his mouth, and he-shall-not desire

**9:24** anything that he-has-not commanded. To the-judgment-of God he-shall-look continually.

**9:25** In-distress he-shall-bless his Maker, and in all that-happens he-shall-recount

**9:26** his-covenant-faithfulness, and in the-endurance-of affliction he-shall-bless him. At all times he-shall-pray.

---

*EMET notes: Column 9 contains the famous messianic reference (line 2) to "a prophet and the-Messiahs-of Aaron and Israel" — two anointed figures, one priestly and one royal. The Maskil (Instructor) passage (lines 3-26) describes the spiritual director's duties. "Men-of the-pit" (anshei ha-shachat) designates outsiders. Hyphenated compounds preserve Hebrew construct chains.*
